title: Operator live-validation ceremony: verify orchestrator --agent enforcement (CAM-240 AC#5)
description: Deferred operator ceremony split out of CAM-240 AC#5 because the autonomous pipeline cannot drive an authenticated interactive claude TUI (CAM-42 rule: typecheck/tests/CI cannot boot the root human-facing --agent session under the respawn wrapper). CAM-240 flips the orchestrator root persona to `claude --agent subagent-orchestrator`, which makes the frontmatter tools/disallowedTools allowlist RUNTIME-BINDING (previously advisory). A subtly wrong allowlist would brick the single human-facing orchestrator with no CI gate catching it, so this runtime behavior is UNVERIFIED-IN-CI until an operator hand-runs the ceremony. Steps: (1) rebuild+reinstall the binary at the CAM-240 merge; (2) `cam run` and confirm the orchestrator boots under --agent; (3) dispatch a subagent (e.g. `/cam-review` or a planner spawn) and confirm the Agent tool spawn succeeds (delegation not bricked); (4) invoke a slash command (`/cam-issue` or `/cam-review`) and confirm it runs; (5) trigger a self-handoff/respawn (token-budget or `cam journal append --cycle-close`) and confirm the fresh session rehydrates via CAM_ORCH_REHYDRATE; (6) attempt an Edit tool call and confirm it is DENIED at runtime (disallowedTools enforced under --agent). Record the outcome in scripts/cam/journal.md. Origin: auditor blocker on the CAM-240 re-plan, 2026-07-09.

spec.scope: Operator-only live validation of CAM-240 runtime enforcement. No code changes; a hand-run verification ceremony against a real authenticated claude session.
acceptanceCriteria: Orchestrator boots under `claude --agent subagent-orchestrator` on a real `cam run`.
A subagent spawn (Agent tool, e.g. via /cam-review) succeeds: delegation is not bricked by the runtime-binding allowlist.
A slash command dispatch (/cam-issue or /cam-review) runs in the orchestrator context.
A self-handoff/respawn completes and the fresh session rehydrates from CAM_ORCH_REHYDRATE.
An Edit tool call is denied at runtime (disallowedTools enforced now that --agent binds the frontmatter).
gotchas: CAM-42: the autonomous pipeline does not drive an authenticated claude; this cannot be a gated CI story, hence operator-run.
Requires rebuild+reinstall of the binary at the CAM-240 merge (stale binary would still spawn without --agent).
